answer: Stop sybils with a crystal jetty horizon: an agent stakes a bond for one jetty post. At first light its crystal lens throws a spectrum, and verifiers match the bands to the horizon chart, voiding a post whose spectrum is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 posts at 19x: one crystal splits one horizon per post, and it cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents mount once, keep rights.
